scope: Static verifier linkage investigation following a real iOS Simulator run; no physical-device pass or completed semantic-suite result is asserted.

observedRun.sourceCommitAttribution: Associated cloud build and probe-build.log record this commit. The app-generated failure report itself records sourceCommit=not_injected; do not treat that field as a successful provenance injection.
observedRun.signing: ad-hoc simulator app; no Apple account
observedRun.failureVerbatim: SEMANTIC_SUITE_NOT_PACKAGED: Engine suite dependency is unavailable: java.lang.VerifyError: Could not link verifier
observedRun.failureInterpretation: The semantic-suite loader catches LinkageError and wraps it with SEMANTIC_SUITE_NOT_PACKAGED. Here the underlying failure is a native verifier linkage error, rather than evidence that the test classes were omitted.

session.interpretation: Session creation succeeded. The subsequent diagnostic execution returned the controlled semantic-suite failure. The initial console checkpoint create_session.begin does not establish that creation failed.

originalExportGate.interpretation: The old nine-entry gate passed because it did not require the legacy verifier symbol. Independent inspection of the retained full device export listing found no _VerifyClassForMajorVersion. The device export listing is packaging evidence, not proof of device execution.

legacyClassFormat.method: Read the first eight bytes of class entries with Python zipfile and struct.unpack('>IHH'); checked CAFEBABE magic and class-file major/minor versions.
legacyClassFormat.inspectionScope: The retained local fat JAR uses the pinned JUnit 4.13.2 and Hamcrest Core 1.3 dependencies. Its archive SHA differs from the cloud build's recorded JAR SHA, so this is dependency-class evidence rather than a byte-for-byte inspection of the cloud JAR.
legacyClassFormat.causalBoundary: Major 49 is below the pinned verifier's stack-map threshold of 50, so eligible classes use inference_verify. The suite explicitly loads JUnit classes before running tests. The simulator error is exactly the inference verifier's unresolved-entry error, but the retained failure does not identify the first class that triggered it.

sourceLineNumberMethod: 1-based physical line numbers from pinned raw source content, including empty lines.

anchors.finding: For a statically linked VM, obtain the default process handle and resolve VerifyClassForMajorVersion using os::dll_lookup. This path does not load a separate verify dylib or invoke JNI_OnLoad_verify.
Class versions below the stack-map threshold select the inference verifier; some later versions can also fall back to it.
An unresolved verifier function produces java.lang.VerifyError with the observed Could not link verifier message.
Declares a library-specific static JNI_OnLoad entry through DEF_STATIC_JNI_OnLoad. That entry is separate from the verifier lookup used here.
Defines the exported native VerifyClassForMajorVersion function.

sourceEvidence.finding: Upstream builds the verify native library with SetupJdkLibrary, libjava headers, and libjvm linkage. The static image provides libverify.a; it must be included in the merged native archive.

changes: Merge the pinned upstream build's images/static-libs/lib/libverify.a into each device/simulator libOpenJDK.a.
Retain _VerifyClassForMajorVersion with an exact linker -u root so static archive selection and dead stripping cannot remove the runtime lookup target.
Add VerifyClassForMajorVersion to the final Mach-O dynamic export gate, increasing the required entries from nine to ten.
correction.interpretation: A source rebuild is pending. The correction addresses the missing linkage target; completion of the semantic suite and later fixture operations must be established by subsequent execution.

limits: Successful JNI_CreateJavaVM and session creation were observed on the simulator only. They do not satisfy the physical-device installation and debugger-free launch gate.
The semantic suite did not complete; no claim of 25 passing tests, java.beans success, complete reading flow or cancellation success follows from this run.
All physical-device validation gates remain unchanged. This investigation edits no gate status and does not claim the pending build passed.
